why: The phone rule applied at every width: a desktop strip at four players shrinks its pips to 9px at one to three stocks and falls back to one pip and a digit at four and five, with room to spare -- for an FFA entry and for a teams entry alike, since both take this one rule. Issues #835 and #1055 change only what a viewport of 480px or less draws. Before #1055 this survived (0 of 75 tests in hud.match.test.ts failed): every pips case at the desktop width ran at two players, where the rule's answer is the full size anyway, and the four-player one checked only the leading marker. The teams desktop control renders a crowded strip WITHOUT the narrow seam, so it is the case that has to catch this.
killedBy: hud: stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) THE CONTROL for the teams cases: the desktop strip draws every teams pip at full size
